scope: 66 domain repositories created in this chat; portfolio site is validated separately

repositories.name: code-flow-studio
repositories.summary: Filter diagnostics, unused-code candidates and missed coverage; inspect hash-verified source and navigate safely to unchanged drafts. Fixed rapid typing, worker compatibility and native launch preparation.
repositories.rationale: Turns report findings into a reproducible developer triage workflow while preserving source identity and isolated execution.
limitations: Twelve bounded flat CLI adapters do not cover every framework, dependency or architecture; coverage and unused-code candidates are not correctness or dead-code proof.
Execution needs a separately built local Docker worker with no host fallback. Shared worker identity and containers are not a certified public hostile-code sandbox.
Hashes bind retained bytes and locations, not trusted attestation by a malicious target. UI-only report fixtures are separate from native collector evidence.
Local accounts trust the OS and unlocked service. Downloads are unsigned development builds; no native mobile installer or clean-machine installer lifecycle certification is claimed.

repositories.name: business-knowledge-workbench
repositories.summary: Search standardized numeric table values with unit-aware ranges and same-cell correlation; download authorized bounded document bundles with checksummed manifests and saved standards. Fixed scientific notation normalization.
repositories.rationale: Makes standardized business records easier to investigate and hand off without mixing units or bypassing document access.
limitations: Local owner-account edition; no shared hosted-business identity, invitations or managed tenant deployment is supplied.
Numeric range search covers standardized cells, not OCR or arbitrary source-blob search; unit conversion uses canonical six-place precision.
Export ZIPs are plaintext integrity records, not encrypted or digitally signed; they omit originals and account secrets.
Import and conversion support is adapter-specific; no universal file-format, image/equation understanding or AI-provider compatibility is promised.

repositories.name: personal-image-model-studio
repositories.summary: Review authorized datasets for caption, provenance, split and integrity evidence; inspect bounded cross-split similarity candidates with private thumbnails and export exact reports before training.
repositories.rationale: Helps users investigate training inputs without treating similarity, declared rights or sample counts as proof of data or model quality.
limitations: Integrity and similarity inspect at most 64 eligible images, 32 MiB encoded bytes and 16,777,216 decoded pixels; only 32 candidate pairs are shown, with omissions explicit.
Grayscale hash matches are candidates, not proof of leakage, semantic quality or AI origin. Rights and provenance labels are operator declarations, not legal verification.

The compact native model is not a general photorealistic generator. CPU downloads support native models only; compatible Stable Diffusion/LoRA imports need the explicitly configured full source/runtime.
One unlocked local engine trusts the OS and active service. CPU downloads are unsigned portable applications, not a public hosted service or native mobile installation.

repositories.name: forge2d-engine
repositories.summary: Add bidirectional collision category/mask filters, versioned scene migration, deterministic state hashes and initial/final overlap CSV inspection.
repositories.rationale: Supports practical game-world collision layers and reproducible debugging against independent geometry oracles.
limitations: Category/mask filtering selects AABB query candidates; it does not add physical collision response, enter/exit callbacks or navigation changes.
Filter words change numeric state fingerprints even for legacy default filters; replay input grammar remains version 1.
Raw queries cannot establish current entity-generation validity; World owns lifetime checks. This is a fictional integer 2D game engine.

repositories.name: secure-delivery-pipeline-lab
repositories.summary: Compare authenticated active and candidate trust, record bounded deployment receipts and exercise independently authenticated rollback.
repositories.rationale: Shows why a proposed release is eligible and preserves the evidence needed to recover safely.
limitations: Hash differences identify changed bytes, not release compatibility or a complete security assessment.
Deployment receipts are local operator assertions, not signed or tamper-proof evidence that production deployment occurred.
Authenticated lab trust checks do not certify a production delivery environment or replace deployment-specific policy and operational review.

repositories.name: applicant-evidence-studio
repositories.summary: Capture two authorized applicant records against one rubric with reviewed citations, unknowns, clarification prompts, transient observations and exact private JSON export.
repositories.rationale: Supports factual human comparison while keeping encrypted-account review in the browser and avoiding invented degrees, experience or hiring decisions.
limitations: Two-record advisory comparison preserves selection order; it does not choose a winner, verify claims, infer protected traits/degrees/paid years or make hire/reject decisions.

Private comparison is assembled in the unlocked browser. Host aliases and operational metadata remain visible; the device and delivered frontend must be trusted. No new reviewer/admin sharing roles are added.
Exports are unencrypted identifying private information, not anonymous or signed evidence. Historical downloads cannot be revoked.
Observations are transient: opening original records, changing context, mutations or locking clears them; download a capture before leaving.

repositories.name: spacecraft-flight-software-testbed
repositories.summary: Compare onboard mode, boot and counter changes with downlinked witnesses, including missed transitions and reset windows.
repositories.rationale: Separates what happened onboard from what a delayed telemetry stream actually observed.
limitations: Synthetic software-only logical-tick executive; no real flight controller, hardware, guidance or targeting integration.
Downlink witnesses can miss onboard transitions. A counter receipt establishes at least a value, not the exact increment time; absence of a witness is not proof of no occurrence.
The upgraded workflow is source/CI verified; previously published native downloads can lag these changes.

repositories.name: spacecraft-telemetry-anomaly-studio

repositories.rationale: Makes anomaly investigation manageable without inventing recovery across missing telemetry.
limitations: Educational single-analyst telemetry review, not real flight operations or a verified diagnosis of hardware failure.
Gaps and window boundaries can leave recovery unknown; an alert episode does not establish a physical cause.
Human notes are tab-local, reset on analysis and require explicit export; no authenticated reviewer or review import is supplied.
The upgraded workflow is source/CI verified; previously published native downloads can lag these changes.

limitations: Bounded educational candidate allocation, not live mission dispatch or operational scheduling assurance.
Contingencies are separate full-window single-station failures, not arbitrary, sequential or partial-window outages.
Reoptimization uses the existing objective; it does not guarantee locked contacts or minimum schedule changes.
The upgraded workflow is source/CI verified; previously published native downloads can lag these changes.

Service evidence uses interval averages, not continuous thermal-limit assessment or hardware reliability predictions.
Episode materiality uses a 1e-8 W threshold; smaller residuals can remain in integrated energy totals.

repositories.summary: Bind consumer acknowledgements to secret generations and inspect drain/expiry/replay queues; patch the actual OpenBao build and fail closed for its unused incompatible Okta integration.
repositories.rationale: Makes rotation completion evidence explicit and removes known dependency risks without pretending unsupported authentication still works.
limitations: Pool-drain acknowledgements and consumer codes are in-process assertions, not authentication or proof of server acceptance.
Local overlap is a lease-time calculation, not a zero-downtime guarantee.
The unused incompatible Okta integration fails closed; this project does not claim working Okta authentication.

repositories.name: vulnerability-prioritization-console
repositories.summary: Compare same-clock/source-bound vulnerability evidence and preserve owner queues, deadlines, identity changes and unverified absence.
repositories.rationale: Supports remediation decisions without turning missing scanner evidence into proof that a vulnerability is fixed.
limitations: Saved comparisons use current stored workflow state, not immutable historical UI reconstruction.
Fix/reopen labels remain assertions or reconfirmation needs, not independent proof that remediation occurred.
New review uses CLI, inert reports and protected API; missing scanner evidence is not proof of a fixed vulnerability.

repositories.name: windows-identity-audit-lab
repositories.summary: Review nested protected-identity exposure, representative paths, source completeness and owner recertification/expiry queues.
repositories.rationale: Keeps complete exposure separate from newly observed drift and avoids false removal claims from partial snapshots.
limitations: SID evidence can be identifying private plaintext; it does not prove effective access or successful revocation.
Exposure reports show one shortest representative path, not every possible nested path.
Absence in partial, unresolved or cyclic evidence is unverified; recertification is not automatically renewed.

repositories.name: network-defense-analysis-lab
repositories.summary: Filter captured events by exact UTC/protocol/rule/severity with snapshot/query-bound pagination and persistent visibility of capture gaps.
repositories.rationale: Makes defensive investigation manageable without presenting filtered or incomplete captures as clean traffic.
limitations: The original 100-item detector evidence cap remains; a filtered event page does not include every related packet.
Capture-quality issues lack reliable timestamps and remain visible outside event time filters.
No live capture, blocking or attribution is supplied; no findings is not proof of safe traffic.

repositories.name: memory-safety-analysis-lab
repositories.summary: Deduplicate private corpus inputs and reduce twice-confirmed owned-parser disagreements under shared time/attempt budgets.
repositories.rationale: Produces reproducible smaller debugging cases while preserving unstable and inconclusive outcomes.
limitations: Reduction preserves a twice-confirmed agreement/disagreement partition, not necessarily the same root cause or a globally minimal input.
Unstable and inconclusive executions remain distinct from reproducible findings under shared attempt/time budgets.
Exported reduction reports contain hashes and lengths rather than source paths or payload bytes; the library can return bytes to its caller.

repositories.name: unity-tactical-ai-sandbox
repositories.summary: Inspect hash-validated game replays with timeline scrubbing, terrain/line-of-sight state and independent default-bot diagnostics in bounded offline HTML.
repositories.rationale: Makes game behavior review portable while distinguishing recorded hindsight from independent replay decisions.
limitations: Fictional turn-based game only; no real-world tracking, targeting or live control.
Default-bot diagnostics do not reconstruct the recording policy; the viewer does not rerun the engine or authenticate mutable files.
Inputs are bounded to 128 commands, 16 avatars, 32x32 static cells, 1 MiB import and 8 MiB JSON.
Unity stub compilation is not Unity Editor/PlayMode validation; the upgraded source is not a newly published native game build.

repositories.name: mqtt-lifecycle-reliability-lab
repositories.summary: Persist and restore identity-bound bounded recovery outboxes with original times, TTL/capacity losses and publish-failure retention.
repositories.rationale: Turns reconnect demonstrations into reproducible cold-recovery workflows with explicit at-least-once limits.
limitations: Trusted cleartext checkpoints use explicit persistence; no fsync/crash-atomic, distributed exactly-once or fencing guarantee is made.
Copying a snapshot into separate fresh processes can replay messages more than once; callers must stop old publishers and use unique message IDs.
Count-bounded batches can exceed the checkpoint byte cap; export fails instead of silently truncating.

repositories.name: offline-incident-timeline-pwa
repositories.summary: Combine exact UTC filters, safe URL state, no-result/export handling and offline restoration; fix owned Lighthouse startup parsing.
repositories.rationale: Supports reliable field investigation and honest validation without adopting another local server.
limitations: Local approved evidence only; no account service, encryption or server upload boundary is added.
Allowlisted URL filters can reveal investigation terms when shared; they are not confidential storage.
Offline/cancel emulation cases run only in Chromium; automated Axe/Lighthouse results do not certify screen-reader comprehension.

repositories.name: documentation-quality-gate
repositories.summary: Review new, persistent, not-reproduced and unexamined debt with exact locations; refresh atomically without losing debt from partial scans or hiding operational errors.
repositories.rationale: Makes accepted documentation debt maintainable rather than silently clearing it during repeat baseline refreshes.
limitations: Not-reproduced means absent under the current configuration, not proven fixed. Fingerprints remain line-sensitive with no guessed move matching.
Deleted, excluded and unreadable files remain unexamined until human reconciliation.
The adjacent lease coordinates cooperative CLI writers, not arbitrary external software; use a trusted checkout.

repositories.name: versioned-product-knowledge-portal
repositories.summary: Add shareable side-by-side edition comparisons with canonical sources, structured warnings, lifecycle/missing counterparts and an allowlisted no-JavaScript-friendly chooser.
repositories.rationale: Helps readers compare applicable instructions without merging incompatible procedures or assuming an absent warning means safety.
limitations: Public synthetic static corpus; no private accounts, content scraping or real-equipment guidance.
Edition comparison matches editorial identities, not semantic equivalence; missing text or warnings do not prove feature/hazard removal.
Extractive search/citation limits and abstention remain; automated checks do not establish exhaustive accessibility conformance.

repositories.name: engineering-documentation-foundry
repositories.summary: Compare canonical corpus revisions by stable identity, highlighting source-cited content and safety-warning changes in HTML/JSON.
repositories.rationale: Gives publication reviewers a precise change review before shipping revised documentation.
limitations: Comparison matches stable identities without inferring semantic renames or equivalent safety meaning.
Operational write failures can leave a partial review directory; source documents and published output are not changed by comparison.
Source citations and warning diffs support human review, not a certification that a revised procedure is safe.

repositories.name: node-red-resilient-metadata
repositories.summary: Handle bounded Retry-After seconds/dates, rate-limit spacing and cancellation of delayed requests while releasing unused error response bodies.
repositories.rationale: Makes integration recovery behave predictably under real HTTP throttling and user cancellation.
limitations: HTTP dates accept IMF-fixdate; obsolete or malformed forms fall back to configured spacing.
Server cooldowns over 30 seconds fail for operator recovery rather than retrying early; later retries need caller scheduling.
Unused error response bodies are released, not retained or exposed as diagnostic content.

repositories.name: host-hardening-assurance-lab
repositories.summary: Review expected host inventory, unknown missing evidence, policy/platform counts and owner refresh/deviation queues.
repositories.rationale: Prevents absent hosts or stale observations from inflating assurance results.
limitations: Completeness of the declared host inventory is the operator's responsibility.
Each run uses one exact baseline; unlike platform counts remain separate rather than a pooled assurance score.
Owner/reviewer labels are local assertions, not authenticated approvals or a compliance certification.

repositories.name: rmf-evidence-workbench
repositories.summary: Build owner monitoring calendars and exact component-scoped freshness, integrity, risk and milestone work queues.
repositories.rationale: Helps maintain evidence continuously without claiming that a dashboard grants authorization.
limitations: Synthetic selected six-control scope, not certification, authorization to operate or risk acceptance.
Owner calendars and queues do not collect real evidence or send live notifications.
Freshness/integrity review supports human monitoring; it does not grant an authorization or waive missing evidence.
